situation: 0/30 posts, 0/500 views. Pipeline operational with 198 ready videos. All infrastructure complete. Blocker is HUMAN ACTION: posting videos to TikTok.

remediation_phases.name: IMMEDIATE — Start posting today
actions: Use /deliver or /pickup in Telegram to get next video
Download video + copy caption from Telegram
Post to TikTok manually from phone

remediation_phases.name: RAMP UP — Increase to 2 posts/day
actions: Use /besttime command for optimal posting windows
Review early post views: are we getting 500 views per 30 posts?

remediation_phases.name: PUSH — Final sprint to 30
actions: If views are under pace, increase to 2/day
Run /gate command daily to check progress

remediation_phases.name: GATE DAY — Final audit
actions: If FAIL: document shortfall, revise timeline

stripe_remediation.required: Create one test subscription, verify webhook, cancel

fallback_if_gate_fails.posts_under_30: Extend gate to Apr 14 (1 week extension). Continue posting.
fallback_if_gate_fails.views_under_500: Analyze underperforming content. Switch to trending topics. Increase posting frequency to 3/day.
fallback_if_gate_fails.both_fail: Evaluate if TikTok channel is viable. Consider YouTube Shorts as primary (API working, no manual posting needed).
fallback_if_gate_fails.stripe_not_tested: Not a hard blocker — can test during launch week. But strongly recommended before.

critical_path: The ONLY blocker is human posting. Pipeline is ready. Infrastructure is ready. Content is ready. 198 videos waiting. START POSTING.
